announcements.bodyMarkdown:
# 1. Expanded our Committee
[Link to all Committee Members](https://challownetballclub.org.uk/#contacts)

This year we have expanded our Committee Team to help us grow and promote the
club. Narelle Barker has stepped into the role of Parent Manager Coordinator to help
manage the junior teams and ensure parents are comfortable and prepared to
manage their teams. Ann-Marie Young and Lynsey Watts are now apart of our
Fundraising and Event Socials teams to organise social events and also fundraising
for the club, we are also looking for some Sponsors so if anyone has any
suggestions please get in contact with us. Millie Tomlin, Daisy Tomlin, Robyn Sulley
and Molly Watts have volunteered to manage our social media accounts to advertise
the club and show everyone what Challow is about! Then finally we have also
introduced Zoe Walker, Dave Barker, Rachel Matthews and Aimee Watts as general
committee members to help support the rest of the committee and provide feedback
to any ideas and suggestions made

# 2. Parent Support & Team Managers
As always our club relies on the support and involvement of parents to provide a
positive and successful experience for all players. We ask all parents to support the
club, coaches and volunteers by encouraging positive sideline behaviour, ensuring
players attend training and matches, and helping with team responsibilities when
required.

**To participate in the League, every team must have a nominated Parent Manager -
this is a club requirement, unfortunately if a team does not have a Parent Manager
they cannot be entered into matches.**

**Parent managers** will be fully supported by our committee and our **New Parent
Manger Coordinator - Narelle Barker**. The parent Manger’s responsibilities include
bringing the kit bag to matches, collecting umpire payments from the Coach at
training each week, paying the umpire at matches, and ensuring 1-2 parents are
rostered each week to support the team on court by scoring and helping with basic
first aid. You will get to be courtside (along with other nominated parents for game
day roles) and really enjoy being up close to the action.

We understand that the **Parent Manager** may not always be able to attend matches,
so we ask that they arrange another parent from the team to carry out these duties.
We appreciate the commitment of our parent volunteers - your support is essential in
helping our teams take the court each week and ensuring the season runs smoothly
for everyone.

# 3. Training Times / Transition Period
This year we are going to introduce a transition period across the club for Terms 5
and 6. This will mean that training times and groups will change slightly to allow for
groups to merge and meet those that they may be playing with the following school
year. This will also allow us to maximise on our training time during the exam periods
where numbers can drop.

# 4. Training Fees
As always club running costs are increasing (umpire fees have doubled, hall hire
costs and coaching fees) and as a result we have had to increase our membership
fees. To help support families with this we have introduced a Monthly Payment option
to make it a more manageable fee. If there are any issues with payments please
reach out to us via email so we can discuss this.

# 5. Training Venue
We are continuing to explore alternative local training venues, should the right one
become available during the year then we will look to move. Once we have more
information on this we will send out club wide comms to provide an update.

# 6. Introduction of Whatsapp Community
During August we are working hard behind the scenes to set up a Challow Netball
Club Whatsapp Community. This will be a requirement for all players / guardians to
join as this is a simpler and more streamline process for our Head Coach and Parent
Manager Coordinator to manage the different age groups as well as simplify any
announcement needed for club wide comms.

# 7. Increase in Social Media & Website
As mentioned this year we have created a Social Media Team and so we are wanting
to create more posts around training, matches and socials. We are creating our club
Instagram, Tiktok, Facebook and a Website (in progress) so keep an eye out for
these. As always in our registration packs there is a photography consent section
where you can opt out.

announcements.bodyMarkdown:
# Welcome!

To the new and improved web site. We want to provide a hub which all players, parents and committee members can use to improve the communication, inclusion and governance of the club.

This web site has a few features that will benefit Players and Parents.
- Safeguarding and Wellbeing
- Live Calendar
- Latest News
- Messaging System
- Governance

# Safeguarding and wellbeing
We are committed to an inclusive and safe environment for all to play the game we love. We have a SafeGuarding Officer and links here to send confidential messages.

### Safeguardig
> Contact the Safeguarding Officer if you are worried about the safety, welfare or wellbeing of a child, young person or adult involved with the Club. Safeguarding concerns should be raised promptly.
[Safeguarding Officer](https://www.challownetballclub.org.uk/#role-safeguarding)
### Welfare
> Contact Welfare if you have a general welfare concern that is not a safeguarding allegation.
[Welfare](https://www.challownetballclub.org.uk/#role-welfare-volunteers)
### Resolution Lead
> Contact Resolution Lead for a complaint or dispute that has not been resolved through the normal role holder, or when you need help understanding the appropriate route for a concern.
[Resolution Lead](https://www.challownetballclub.org.uk/#role-resolution)

# Live Calendar
There is a link on the home page for you to install a calendar on your phone or PC. Just click the link and follow the process. This will add a new calendar to your phone and will automatically update as we add new events.

[Add our calendar now](webcal://www.challownetballclub.org.uk/api/calendar/public)

# Latest News
Please look out for updates on the web site providing information about upcoming events and achievements of the club.

[Latest news](https://www.challownetballclub.org.uk/#updates)

# Messaging System
The Challow Netball Club Hub allows you to message the committee directly and discretely, sending a message here protects the committee member email but allows you to communicate directly with them.

[Committee Members](https://www.challownetballclub.org.uk/#contacts)

# Governance
We are committed to improving the way the club is run, we have appointed 5 new committee members this year and we are putting in policies and procedures to make the running of club easier and more consistent.
- [Club Constitution](https://www.challownetballclub.org.uk/#constitution)
- [Policies](https://www.challownetballclub.org.uk/#policy-register)
- [Roles](https://www.challownetballclub.org.uk/#roles-guide)
announcements.summary: Club information, committee contacts, policies and season updates now live together in one transparent public hub.

registration.bodyMarkdown:
# Registration is Open
The Challow Netball Club has teams in the following age groups:
* **U13s** - Years 6, 7 & 8
* **U15s** - Years 9 and 10
* **U17s** - Years 11 and 12
* **U19s** - Year 13
* **Seniors** - 19+

** PLEASE READ THE FOLLOWING CAREFULLY AS ITS IMPORTANT TO YOUR SUCCESSFUL INVOLVEMENT IN THE CLUB **

# Training
> As part of your enrolment to the club, all players must train and play matches (unless you are an existing member with an agreement in place with the committee).

If you are unable to attend a training session, you
must decline the relevant session on the Spond App with
at least 48 hours’ notice, and you must **‘submit with comment’**
to confirm the reason why you cannot attend. If you do not
reply to a training session invitation on Spond then this will
count as a ‘miss’, similarly if you decline a training session
without submitting a reason or it is less than 48 hours’ notice,
this will also count as a ‘miss’.

If you miss one training session without communication on Spond, you will not be eligible to play in the next match. If multiple training sessions are subsequently missed, then there will be follow up by the club committee and a potential termination of your club membership.

**Parking Arrangements: Carpark at the front of the school or rear courts (near sports hall)**

**Training Dates:**
- Term 1 08/09/26 up to and including 20/10/26
- Term 2 03/11/26 up to and including 15/12/26
- Term 3 05/01/27 up to and including 09/02/27
- Term 4 23/02/27 up to and including 23/03/27
- Term 5 13/04/27 up to and including 25/05/27
- Term 6 08/06/27 up to and including 06/07/27

# Parent Support & Team Manager Expectations
> Our club relies on the support and involvement of parents to provide a positive and successful experience for all players. We ask all parents to support the club, coaches and volunteers by encouraging positive sideline behaviour, ensuring players attend training and matches, and helping with team responsibilities when required.

To participate in the League, every team must have a nominated Parent Manager - this is a club requirement, unfortunately if a team does not have a Parent Manager they cannot be entered into matches.

Parent managers will be fully supported by our committee and our New Parent Manager Coordinator - Narelle Barker. 

The parent Manger’s responsibilities include:
* bringing the kit bag to matches, 
* collecting umpire payments from the Coach at training each week
* paying the umpire at matches,
* and ensuring 1-2 parents are rostered each week to support the team on court by scoring and helping with basic first aid. 

**You will get to be courtside for ALL matches (along with other nominated parents for game day roles) and really enjoy being up close to the action.**

We understand that the Parent Manager may not always be able to attend matches, so we ask that they arrange another parent from the team to carry out these duties.

We appreciate the commitment of our parent volunteers - your support is essential in helping our teams take the court each week and ensuring the season runs smoothly for everyone.

Please note that during the first training session - Tuesday 8th September - we ask that a parent of every player attends their daughter’s training session for a compulsory **Parent and Player Season Kick Off Meeting.**

# Registration Fees
There are two parts to the fee structure and are payable separately. 1) is the Challow Netball Club fees and 2) England Netball Membership fees. **YOU MUST PAY BOTH IN ORDER TO REGISTER**.

> The deadline for fees listed under 1. & 2. is **8th September 2026**

## 1. Challow Netball Club Fees
Fees covers training, match play, match court hire, team entry into the Oxfordshire Netball League, coach fees, umpire fees and sports hall hire

**All Ages** – one of the following options:
1. A one-off payment of £160 for the year
2. X2 payments of £85, one is September and on in March
3. Monthly payment of £17, to be paid at the start of every month (September-June)

> Please note all payments are to be made via **spond** see link below.

Challow Netball Club Spond Code: **XYCSO**

Alternatively, please follow this link:- [https://group.spond.com/XYCSO](https://group.spond.com/XYCSO)

Once approved, we will add you to the relevant membership payment.

**Families Discount**
* **1st member** - Full membership fees
* **2nd member** – £137.50 for the whole year or 2x payments of £75 in September and March
* **3rd member** - £80 for the whole year or x2 payments of £42.50 in September and March If you have multiple members, these can be paid via one Spond account

# 2. England Netball Membership 2026/27 Fees

Affiliation fees cover England Netball, South Region and Oxfordshire.

**Please note that this fee must be paid directly to England Netball via their Engage System**

Search ‘England Netball Engage’ or follow the below link.
* [https://engage.englandnetball.co.uk/EnglandNetball](https://engage.englandnetball.co.uk/EnglandNetball)

Most of you have paid your membership this way before so log in using your membership no. (ENA ID) and your password. Once logged in, click on ‘buy membership’ and follow the instructions to make payment.

If you are **new**, please follow the link/QR Code above and **‘Create Account’**. 

Then follow the instructions to buy membership.

> Please note that all club members must affiliate with England Netball and affiliation must be in place before you can play matches 

# Match Information
All Oxfordshire Netball League matches are played outdoors at the following address: **St
Helen & St Katharine School, Faringdon Rd, Abingdon OX14 1BE**

# Our current team kit comprises:
* Black and pink dresses (black or pink shorts/leggings can be worn underneath).
* Pink/black bibs
* Club netball dresses can be purchased from Wild Wickets, 8 Mill Street, Wantage, OX12 9AQ.
* Nails must be cut short for matches.
* Pierced ears etc. cannot be taped over – they must be removed.
* The club does not pay towards travel expenses for matches.
* All players must make their own travel arrangements to Central Venue and lift share where possible.

> All match details will be added to **Spond** once confirmed by the Oxfordshire Netball League and club members must confirm their availability at least a week in advance so teams and transport can be arranged by Team Parent Managers

roles.committee: Contact Louise for strategic direction, meeting leadership, governance decisions, escalation of cross-functional issues, or when an action needs clear ownership across the Committee.
roles.parent: Contact the chairperson when you need senior Club guidance, have a matter that cuts across several areas, want to raise a governance concern, or are unsure who else should deal with an issue.

roles.committee: Contact the secretary for agendas, minutes, governance records, formal correspondence, policy control and administrative follow-up.
roles.parent: Contact the secretary for formal Club administration, meeting or AGM information, official records, or questions about how a Club decision was recorded.

roles.committee: Contact the treasurer before financial commitments are made, for budget information, expenditure approvals, payment controls or financial reporting.
roles.parent: Contact the treasurer for membership-payment questions, reimbursements, Club charges or another issue that specifically relates to Club finances.

roles.committee: Contact the safeguarding officer when an activity, incident, volunteer arrangement or decision may have safeguarding implications, or when a concern needs to be referred through the correct process.
roles.parent: Contact the safeguarding officer if you are worried about the safety, welfare or wellbeing of a child, young person or adult involved with the Club. Safeguarding concerns should be raised promptly.

roles.committee: Contact the Data Protection Lead before introducing new ways of collecting, storing or sharing personal information, or immediately if a data incident may have occurred.
roles.parent: Contact the Data Protection Lead if you have questions about how the Club uses your or your child's personal information, want information corrected, or believe information may have been shared or accessed incorrectly.

roles.committee: Contact the Resolution Lead for complaints, disputes, procedural fairness, conflict-sensitive resolution, or as the alternative safeguarding contact where the Safeguarding Officer has a conflict.
roles.parent: Contact the Resolution Lead for a complaint or dispute that has not been resolved through the normal role holder, or when you need help understanding the appropriate route for a concern.

roles.committee: Contact the Registrar for membership numbers, registrations, affiliation status, team eligibility or updates to member records.
roles.parent: Contact the Registrar for membership, player registration, ENgage, affiliation or eligibility questions.

roles.committee: Contact the Volunteer Coordinator when volunteer capacity is needed, roles need filling, parent help needs coordinating, or the Club should improve the volunteer experience.
roles.parent: Contact the Volunteer Coordinator if you would like to volunteer, can help a team or event, need support understanding a volunteer role, or the Welfare Officer if have a general welfare concern that is not a safeguarding allegation.

roles.committee: Contact the Head Coach for coaching strategy, coach capacity, player development, coaching standards or coordination across teams.
roles.parent: Contact the Head Coach for questions about the Club's coaching approach, player development pathway or coaching standards. Team-specific issues should normally start with the player's own coach.

roles.committee: Contact the Communications, Events & Sponsorship Coordinator when Club information needs communicating, an event or campaign needs organising, or sponsor engagement is required.
roles.parent: Contact the Communications, Events & Sponsorship Coordinator for Club events, public communications, social media, fundraising activities, sponsorship opportunities or information that may be suitable for promotion.

roles.committee: Contact the Equipment & Facilities Manager for equipment purchasing, inventory, storage, facility access or practical venue requirements.
roles.parent: Contact the Equipment & Facilities Manager for practical questions about Club equipment, facilities, kit/property arrangements or an equipment/facility issue that needs attention. NOTE that the kit bags will contain QR code for logging equipment issues, please use this to log issues directly to the Equipment & Facilities Manager.

roles.committee: Engage general committee members for Committee decisions, project ownership, constructive challenge, event support and broader Club improvement work.
roles.parent: General committee members can help route general Club questions, support projects and provide another Committee point of contact when you are unsure where an issue belongs.
